s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial skin lesions with pain, swelling, and erythema
salient_findings: Violaceous swelling with telangiectasia and necrosis on the face
Histopathological findings of hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Atypical cells in dilated vessels positive for GATA3
key_facts: 3-month history of pain, swelling, and erythema on the face
History of left breast carcinoma diagnosed eleven years earlier
Left supraclavicular lymph nodes metastasis treated with surgical excision seven years after initial diagnosis
Pain on palpation without fever or chills
Telangiectatic, swelling erythema mainly involving the left side of the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek
Histopathological examination showed hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and dilated vessels in the dermis
Immunohistochemical examination showed epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31
Atypical cells in dilated vessels were strongly positive for GATA3

shortlist.label: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of breast carcinoma and histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels

shortlist.label: Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma (TMBC)
shortlist.why_kept: Telangiectatic, swelling erythema mainly involving the left side of the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek, with immunohistochemical examination showing epithelial cells in dilated vessels positive for CD31 and GATA3

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells in dilated vessels and telangiectasia, which can be seen in angiosarcoma

shortlist.label: Postradiation angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of radiotherapy for breast carcinoma and development of telangiectatic lesions on the face

shortlist.label: Carcinoma erysipeloides
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of telangiectatic, swelling erythema mainly involving the left side of the forehead, eyelids, nose, and cheek, which is consistent with carcinoma erysipeloides

raw.rationale: The patient's history of breast carcinoma, the presence of telangiectatic swelling and erythema on the face, and the histopathological findings of atypical cells in dilated vessels positive for GATA3 support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of breast carcinoma, the specific telangiectatic presentation and histopathological findings are more characteristic of TMBC.

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of atypical cells positive for GATA3, a marker often associated with breast carcinoma, makes angiosarcoma less likely.

rejected.label: Postradiation angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Although the patient has a history of radiotherapy, the clinical and histopathological findings are more consistent with TMBC, and there is no specific indication of postradiation angiosarcoma.

rejected.label: Carcinoma erysipeloides
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a more diffuse, erythematous plaque, whereas the patient's presentation is more telangiectatic and localized to the face.
